nodes.label: Why wait for sources? Sources must
nodes.text: Why wait for sources? Sources must be indexed before chat or generation. Takes ~30 seconds to several minutes per source (see the processing-times table below).

nodes.label: you are already reading this file
nodes.text: If you are already reading this file inside an agent skill directory, the skill is already installed. You only need the Python package and authentication below.

nodes.label: Before using any command, you MUST
nodes.text: Before using any command, you MUST authenticate:

nodes.label: Always use explicit notebook ID (recomme…
nodes.text: Always use explicit notebook ID (recommended): Pass -n  / --notebook  on notebook-scoped commands instead of relying on use

nodes.label: Before starting workflows, verify auth is
nodes.text: Before starting workflows, verify auth is in place. Use --test --json (not bare --json) — bare --json only proves the cookie file parses; --test makes a network call and proves the cookies still authenticate against Google.

nodes.label: notebooklm status reports *context state…
nodes.text: notebooklm status reports *context state* (selected notebook); do not use it to verify auth.

nodes.label: notebooklm auth inspect - list Google
nodes.text: notebooklm auth inspect - list Google accounts visible to a browser (read-only)
